1.sahih_international: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
1.pickthall: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.
1.yusuf_ali: Blessed be He in Whose hands is Dominion; and He over all things hath Power;-
1.shakir: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the kingdom, and He has power over all things,
1.muhammad_sarwar: Blessed is He in whose hands is the Kingdom and who has power over all things.
1.mohsin_khan: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion, and He is Able to do all things.
1.arberry: Blessed be He in whose hand is the Kingdom -- He is powerful over everything --

2.sahih_international: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
2.pickthall: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
2.yusuf_ali: He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving;-
2.shakir: Who created death and life that He may try you-- which of you is best in deeds; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
2.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has created death and life to put you to the test and see which of you is most virtuous in your deeds. He is Majestic and All-forgiving.
2.mohsin_khan: Who has created death and life, that He may test you which of you is best in deed. And He is the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving;
2.arberry: who created death and life, that He might try you which of you is fairest in works; and He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiving --

3.sahih_international: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
3.pickthall: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
3.yusuf_ali: He Who created the seven heavens one above another: No want of proportion wilt thou see in the Creation of (Allah) Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again: seest thou any flaw?
3.shakir: Who created the seven heavens one above another; you see no incongruity in the creation of the Beneficent Allah; then look again, can you see any disorder?
3.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has created seven heavens, one above the other. You can see no flaw in the creation of the Beneficent God. Look again. Can you see faults?
3.mohsin_khan: Who has created the seven heavens one above another, you can see no fault in the creations of the Most Beneficent. Then look again: "Can you see any rifts?"
3.arberry: who created seven heavens one upon another. Thou seest not in the creation of the All-merciful any imperfection. Return thy gaze; seest thou any fissure?

4.sahih_international: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
4.pickthall: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim.
4.yusuf_ali: Again turn thy vision a second time: (thy) vision will come back to thee dull and discomfited, in a state worn out.
4.shakir: Then turn back the eye again and again; your look shall come back to you confused while it is fatigued.
4.muhammad_sarwar: Look twice (and keep on looking), your eyes will only become dull and tired.
4.mohsin_khan: Then look again and yet again, your sight will return to you in a state of humiliation and worn out.
4.arberry: Then return thy gaze again, and again, and thy gaze comes back to thee dazzled, aweary.

5.sahih_international: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
5.pickthall: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.
5.yusuf_ali: And we have, (from of old), adorned the lowest heaven with Lamps, and We have made such (Lamps) (as) missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, and have prepared for them the Penalty of the Blazing Fire.
5.shakir: And certainly We have adorned this lower heaven with lamps and We have made these missiles for the Shaitans, and We have prepared for them the chastisement of burning.
5.muhammad_sarwar: We have decked the lowest heavens with torches. With these torches We have stoned the devils and We have prepared for them the torment of hell.
5.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps, and We have made such lamps (as) missiles to drive away the Shayatin (devils), and have prepared for them the torment of the blazing Fire.
5.arberry: And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and made them things to stone Satans; and We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blaze.

6.sahih_international: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
6.pickthall: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!
6.yusuf_ali: For those who reject their Lord (and Cherisher) is the Penalty of Hell: and evil is (such), Destination.
6.shakir: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord is the punishment of hell, and evil is the resort.
6.muhammad_sarwar: For those who have disbelieved in their Lord, We have prepared the torment of hell, the most terrible place to return.
6.mohsin_khan: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord (Allah) is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.
6.arberry: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there awaits the chastisement of Gehenna -- an evil homecoming!

7.sahih_international: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
7.pickthall: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up,
7.yusuf_ali: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath even as it blazes forth,
7.shakir: When they shall be cast therein, they shall hear a loud moaning of it as it heaves,
7.muhammad_sarwar: When they are thrown into hell, they will hear its roaring while it boils.
7.mohsin_khan: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath as it blazes forth.
7.arberry: When they are cast into it they will hear it sighing, the while it boils

8.sahih_international: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
8.pickthall: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?
8.yusuf_ali: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you?"
8.shakir: Almost bursting for fury. Whenever a group is cast into it, its keeper shall ask them: Did there not come to you a warner?
8.muhammad_sarwar: It almost explodes in rage. Whenever a group is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, "Did no one come to warn you?"
8.mohsin_khan: It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keeper will ask: "Did no warner come to you?"
8.arberry: and wellnigh bursts asunder with rage. As often as a troop is cast into it, its keepers ask them, 'Came there no warner to you?';

9.sahih_international: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
9.pickthall: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.
9.yusuf_ali: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'Allah never sent down any (Message): ye are nothing but an egregious delusion!'"
9.shakir: They shall say: Yea! indeed there came to us a warner, but we rejected (him) and said: Allah has not revealed anything, you are only in a great error.
9.muhammad_sarwar: They will say, "Yes, someone did come to warn us, but we rejected him saying, 'God has revealed nothing. You are in great error".
9.mohsin_khan: They will say: "Yes indeed; a warner did come to us, but we belied him and said: 'Allah never sent down anything (of revelation), you are only in great error.'"
9.arberry: They say, 'Yes indeed, a warner came to us; but we cried lies, saying, "God has not sent down anything; you are only in great error.

10.sahih_international: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
10.pickthall: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames.
10.yusuf_ali: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not (now) be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire!"
10.shakir: And they shall say: Had we but listened or pondered, we should not have been among the inmates of the burning fire.
10.muhammad_sarwar: They will also say, "Had We listened or used our minds, we would not have become the dwellers of hell".
10.mohsin_khan: And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers of the blazing Fire!"
10.arberry: They also say, 'If we had only heard, or had understood, we would not have been of the inhabitants of the Blaze.'

11.sahih_international: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
11.pickthall: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames.
11.yusuf_ali: They will then confess their sins: but far will be (Forgiveness) from the Companions of the Blazing Fire!
11.shakir: So they shall acknowledge their sins, but far will be (forgiveness) from the inmates of the burning fire.
11.muhammad_sarwar: They will confess to their sins, but the dwellers of hell will be far away from God's (mercy).
11.mohsin_khan: Then they will confess their sin. So, away with the dwellers of the blazing Fire.
11.arberry: So they confess their sins. Curse the inhabitants of the Blaze!

12.sahih_international: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
12.pickthall: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.
12.yusuf_ali: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward.
12.shakir: (As for) those who fear their Lord in secret, they shall surely have forgiveness and a great reward.
12.muhammad_sarwar: Those who fear their Lord in secret will receive forgiveness and a great reward.
12.mohsin_khan: Verily! Those who fear their Lord unseen (i.e. they do not see Him, nor His Punishment in the Hereafter, etc.), theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (i.e. Paradise).
12.arberry: Surely those who fear their Lord in the Unseen -- there awaits them forgiveness and a great wage.

13.sahih_international: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
13.pickthall: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men).
13.yusuf_ali: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, of the secrets of (all) hearts.
13.shakir: And conceal your word or manifest it; surely He is Cognizant of what is in the hearts.
13.muhammad_sarwar: Whether you conceal what you say or reveal it, God knows best all that the hearts contain.
13.mohsin_khan: And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (of men).
13.arberry: Be secret in your speech, or proclaim it, He knows the thoughts within the breasts.

14.sahih_international: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
14.pickthall: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.
14.yusuf_ali: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries (and) is well-acquainted (with them).
14.shakir: Does He not know, Who created? And He is the Knower of the subtleties, the Aware.
14.muhammad_sarwar: Does the One Who is Subtle, All-aware, and Who created all things not know all about them?
14.mohsin_khan: Should not He Who has created know? And He is the Most Kind and Courteous (to His slaves) All-Aware (of everything).
14.arberry: Shall He not know, who created? And He is the All-subtle, the All-aware.

15.sahih_international: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
15.pickthall: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead).
15.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection.
15.shakir: He it is Who made the earth smooth for you, therefore go about in the spacious sides thereof, and eat of His sustenance, and to Him is the return after death.
15.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has made the earth subservient to you. You walk through its vast valleys and eat of its sustenance. Before Him you will all be resurrected.
15.mohsin_khan: He it is, Who has made the earth subservient to you (i.e. easy for you to walk, to live and to do agriculture on it, etc.), so walk in the path thereof and eat of His provision, and to Him will be the Resurrection.
15.arberry: It is He who made the earth submissive to you; therefore walk in its tracts, and eat of His provision; to Him is the Uprising.

16.sahih_international: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
16.pickthall: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?
16.yusuf_ali: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
16.shakir: Are you secure of those in the heaven that He should not make the earth to swallow you up? Then lo! it shall be in a state of commotion.
16.muhammad_sarwar: Do you feel secure that the One in the heavens will not cause you to sink into the earth when it is violently shaking?
16.mohsin_khan: Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allah), will not cause the earth to sink with you, then behold it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
16.arberry: Do you feel secure that He who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you, the while it rocks?

17.sahih_international: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
17.pickthall: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning.
17.yusuf_ali: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones), so that ye shall know how (terrible) was My warning?
17.shakir: Or are you secure of those in the heaven that He should not send down upon you a punishment? Then shall you know how was My warning.
17.muhammad_sarwar: Do you feel secure that the One in the heavens will not strike you with a sandstorm? You will soon know, with the coming of the torment, how serious Our warning was.
17.mohsin_khan: Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allah), will not send against you a violent whirlwind? Then you shall know how (terrible) has been My Warning?
17.arberry: Do you feel secure that He who is in heaven will not loose against you a squall of pebbles, then you shall know how My warning is?

18.sahih_international: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
18.pickthall: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!
18.yusuf_ali: But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)?
18.shakir: And certainly those before them rejected (the truth), then how was My disapproval.
18.muhammad_sarwar: Those who lived before them had also rejected Our warning, and how terrible was Our retribution!
18.mohsin_khan: And indeed those before them belied (the Messengers of Allah), then how terrible was My denial (punishment)?
18.arberry: Those that were before them also cried lies; then how was My horror!

19.sahih_international: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
19.pickthall: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.
19.yusuf_ali: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except (Allah) Most Gracious: Truly (Allah) Most Gracious: Truly it is He that watches over all things.
19.shakir: Have they not seen the birds above them expanding (their wings) and contracting (them)? What is it that withholds them save the Beneficent Allah? Surely He sees everything.
19.muhammad_sarwar: Did they not see the birds above them, stretching out, and flapping their wings. No one keeps them up in the sky except the Beneficent God. He certainly watches over all things.
19.mohsin_khan: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in? None upholds them except the Most Beneficent (Allah). Verily, He is the All-Seer of everything.
19.arberry: Have they not regarded the birds above them spreading their wings, and closing them? Naught holds them but the All-merciful. Surely He sees everything.

20.sahih_international: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
20.pickthall: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion.
20.yusuf_ali: Nay, who is there that can help you, (even as) an army, besides (Allah) Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers.
20.shakir: Or who is it that will be a host for you to assist you besides the Beneficent Allah? The unbelievers are only in deception.
20.muhammad_sarwar: Do you have any armies who will help you against the Beneficent God? The disbelievers are certainly deceived (by satan).
20.mohsin_khan: Who is he besides the Most Beneficent that can be an army to you to help you? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.
20.arberry: Or who is this that shall be a host for you to help you, apart from the All-merciful? The unbelievers are only in delusion.

21.sahih_international: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
21.pickthall: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness.
21.yusuf_ali: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight (from the Truth).
21.shakir: Or who is it that will give you sustenance if He should withhold His sustenance? Nay! they persist in disdain and aversion.
21.muhammad_sarwar: Is there anyone who will provide you with sustenance if God were to deny you sustenance? In fact, they obstinately persist in their transgression and hatred.
21.mohsin_khan: Who is he that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision? Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and (they) flee (from the truth).
21.arberry: Or who is this that shall provide for you if He withholds His provision? No, but they persist in disdain and aversion.

22.sahih_international: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
22.pickthall: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road?
22.yusuf_ali: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way?
22.shakir: What! is he who goes prone upon his face better guided or he who walks upright upon a straight path?
22.muhammad_sarwar: Can one who walks with his head hanging down be better guided that one who walks with his head upright?
22.mohsin_khan: Is he who walks without seeing on his face, more rightly guided, or he who (sees and) walks on a Straight Way (i.e. Islamic Monotheism).
22.arberry: What, is he who walks prone upon his face better guided than he who walks upright on a straight path?

23.sahih_international: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."
23.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
23.yusuf_ali: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give.
23.shakir: Say: He it is Who brought you into being and made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts: little is it that you give thanks.
23.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "It is God who has brought you into being and made ears, eyes, and hearts for you, but you give very little thanks".
23.mohsin_khan: Say it is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing (ears), seeing (eyes), and hearts. Little thanks you give.
23.arberry: Say: 'It is He who produced you, and appointed for you hearing and sight and hearts; little thanks you show!'

24.sahih_international: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
24.pickthall: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.
24.yusuf_ali: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together."
24.shakir: Say: He it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you shall be gathered.
24.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "It is God who has settled you on the earth and to Him you will be resurrected".
24.mohsin_khan: Say: "It is He Who has created you from the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered (in the Hereafter)."
24.arberry: Say: 'It is He who scattered you in the earth, and unto Him you shall be mustered.'

25.sahih_international: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
25.pickthall: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
25.yusuf_ali: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth.
25.shakir: And they say: When shall this threat be (executed) if you are truthful?
25.muhammad_sarwar: They say, "When will this torment take place if what you say is true?"
25.mohsin_khan: They say: "When will this promise (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) come to pass? if you are telling the truth."
25.arberry: They say, 'When shall this promise come to pass, if you speak truly?'

26.sahih_international: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."
26.pickthall: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;
26.yusuf_ali: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public."
26.shakir: Say: The knowledge (thereof is only with Allah and I am only a plain warner.
26.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "God knows best. I am only one who gives warning".
26.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "The knowledge (of its exact time) is with Allah only, and I am only a plain warner."
26.arberry: Say: 'The knowledge is with God; I am only a clear warner.'

27.sahih_international: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
27.pickthall: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.
27.yusuf_ali: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for!"
27.shakir: But when they shall see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve shall be sorry, and it shall be said; This is that which you used to call for.
27.muhammad_sarwar: When they see the torment approaching, the faces of the disbelievers will blacken and they will be told, "This is what you wanted to (experience)".
27.mohsin_khan: But when they will see it (the torment on the Day of Resurrection) approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be different (black, sad, and in grieve), and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise) which you were calling for!"
27.arberry: Then, when they see it nigh at hand, the faces of the unbelievers will be vexed, and it will be said, 'This is what you were promised.'

28.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
28.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?
28.yusuf_ali: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"
28.shakir: Say: Have you considered if Allah should destroy me and those with me-- rather He will have mercy on us; yet who will protect the unbelievers from a painful punishment?
28.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "Have you not considered that regardless whether God forgives me and my followers or grants us mercy, but who will protect the disbelievers from a painful torment?
28.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Tell me! If Allah destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His Mercy on us, - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment?"
28.arberry: Say: 'What think you? If God destroys me and those with me, or has mercy on us, then who will protect the unbelievers from a painful chastisement?'

29.sahih_international: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
29.pickthall: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.
29.yusuf_ali: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."
29.shakir: Say: He is the Beneficent Allah, we believe in Him and on Him do we rely, so you shall come to know who it is that is in clear error.
29.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "He is the Beneficent One in whom we have faith and trust. You will soon know who is in manifest error".
29.mohsin_khan: Say: "He is the Most Beneficent (Allah), in Him we believe, and in Him we put our trust. So you will come to know who is it that is in manifest error."
29.arberry: Say: 'He is the All-merciful. We believe in Him, and in Him we put all our trust. Assuredly, you will soon, know who is in manifest error.

30.sahih_international: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
30.pickthall: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?
30.yusuf_ali: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"
30.shakir: Say: Have you considered if your water should go down, who is it then that will bring you flowing water?
30.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Have you not thought that if your water was to dry up, who would bring you water from the spring?"
30.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Tell me! If (all) your water were to be sunk away, who then can supply you with flowing (spring) water?"
30.arberry: Say: 'What think you? If in the morning your water should have vanished into the earth, then who would bring you running water?'
